description: Search the available US healthcare record lookup by required vertical and state, with optional county context. The hosted result may include nullable source or observation metadata when supplied by the API; this is not a global or complete record search. For identifier lookups (NPI, UEI/CAGE, sanctioned-party name), use fonteum_resolve_entity or fonteum_check_exclusions_and_sanctions. Read-only.

state.description: 2-letter USPS state code (for example, CA or TX).

name: fonteum_search_records
title: Search records across the graph
